messages:
maria: Quick async check — can owners of the Console Observability roadmap post current status for dashboards / tracing hooks / error-analysis views / retention milestones? Need a short line each (owner, ETA, blocker).

kyle: Dashboard work: owner=kyle. ETA: 2026-04-02 for the main perf dashboards. Blocker: waiting on UX finalization for the 'per-route token cost' card. PR open: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/4821 :eyes:

nina: Tracing hooks: owner=nina. ETA: 2026-03-26 for basic trace headers + 2026-04-09 for full span enrichment. Blocker: runtime needs KV cache context passed through; filed runtime ticket RUNTIME-1192.

aj: @nina FYI runtime change is relatively small but touches hot path. I'll need a short perf run on canary before we flip it. Plan: canary next Tue.

nina: Thanks @aj — can you add a quick checklist in the PR for perf run thresholds? Suggest: p95 latency <= baseline + 8ms, token throughput drop <= 3%.

aj: yep. I'll add that and kick canary.

deploy-bot: canary deploy scheduled for 2026-03-24 02:00 UTC — console-runtime:v3.14.2-canary. Logs will stream to #eng-oncall.

sam: Error-analysis views: owner=sam. ETA: 2026-04-06. Blocker: need normalized error event schema from ingest pipeline (see INFRA-321). Also need a dimension for model_variant.

kyle: Re: model_variant dimension — I can add that on the dashboard side once schema lands. ETA dashboard patch: 2 days after schema merge.

maria: Retention milestones: what are the cost implications? short numbers please.

sam: Short: 30-day full traces = +~20% storage, 90-day = +~55%. Metric cardinality matters most. I'll attach cost sheet after this thread.

kyle: For dashboards we can add a 'low-cardinality mode' that shows aggregated stats to keep costs down. Owner: kyle.

maria: Ownership summary so I can update the roadmap doc: dashboards=kyle, tracing=nina (+aj for runtime), error-analysis=sam, retention=platform-costs (sam+kyle). ETA roundup: dashboards 2026-04-02, tracing 2026-04-09, error-analysis 2026-04-06. Any objections?

nina: No objections. One note: tracing ETA depends on RUNTIME-1192 priority.

aj: I'll prioritize RUNTIME-1192 for the next sprint window.

kyle: PRs needing review: dashboard PR (link above), dash tests failing flakily — pls review: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/4797

maria: Can reviewers ping code owners on PRs? If reviews block timelines, call it out in weekly sync.

kyle: @maria done, I pinged eng-runtime and ux.

sam: Cost estimate sheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/retention-costs-2026 — I'll add scenario rows for 30/90/180 day retention by EOD.

maria: Blockers list? anything that will push dates?

kyle: UX finalization could slide dashboards by ~1 week if they want new layout. Otherwise good.

nina: RUNTIME-1192 priority — if deprioritized, tracing ETA moves ~2 weeks.

aj: No other infra blockers from my side; just need time on canary perf window.

maria: Great. Action items: 1) nina/aj: add perf checklist to runtime PR and run canary (due 2026-03-24). 2) kyle: finalize dashboard UX or fall back to low-card mode (due 2026-03-28). 3) sam: publish cost scenarios (due 2026-03-24 EOD). I'll update roadmap doc after those.

kyle: Quick config snippet for low-card mode if helpful:

```yaml
dashboard: low_cardinality_mode: true
aggregation_window: 1h
```

nina: tiny follow-up — for trace headers we plan to add: `x-rw-trace-id` + `x-rw-span-flags`. Will surface in the SDKs too.

maria: Perfect. If nothing else, I'll close this out and post a one-paragraph update to the roadmap doc by 2026-03-25. Thanks all :tada:

kyle: :thumbsup:

nina: :thumbsup:

aj: :thumbsup:
